trial_court: Court of the Senior Civil Judge, Chittapur (R.A. No.71/2011) and Court of the Civil Judge (JR. DN), Chittapur (O.S.No.37/2007)
case_name: Sharnappa S/O Basavanth Sathked Anr vs Laxmi W/O Ramesh Kansoor

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sharnappa S/O Basavanth Sathked, Shivalingamma W/O Shrnappa Sathked, Revansiddu, Bhimrao S/O Sharnappa Sathked

facts_of_case: The suit seeking for partition, separate possession and declaration came to be decreed by the Courts below.

legal_principles.principle: A child of a void marriage is statutorily conferred with legitimacy.
legal_principles.held: In terms of sub-section (1) of Section 16, a child of a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 is statutorily conferred with legitimacy.
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and another vs. Mallikarjun and others, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A child born from a voidable marriage which has been annulled is deemed to be their legitimate child.
legal_principles.held: In terms of sub-section (2) of Section 16 where a voidable marriage has been annulled by a decree of nullity under Section 12, a child begotten or conceived' before the decree has been made, is deemed to be their legitimate child notwithstanding the decree, if the child would have been legitimate to the parties to the marriage if a decree of dissolution had been passed instead of a decree of nullity;
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and another vs. Mallikarjun and others, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The present regular second appeal is allowed.
